summary: Adams fire tower, St. Lucie County FL: one 1973 report of a break-in at the tower house; no build date, staffing or current status in sources.

events.note: Dec. 18, 1973 item (The News Tribune, quoted on Forest Lookouts): house at the Adams Fire Tower broken into and household items taken

corrections.why: 36S-38E-5 is a township, range and section reference in the source, not an agency name. No source found names the agency.

evidence.supports: Tower is west of Fort Pierce, St. Lucie County (1973 item)
evidence.quote: the house located at the Adams Fire Tower, west of Fort Pierce, had been broken into and several household items were taken.

evidence.supports: Location given as St. Lucie County, 36S-38E-5
Item credited to The News Tribune

notes_for_editor: Thin: one source. The story is about 95 words, below the 120-word floor; hold or cut before publishing. Not listed in the Former Fire Lookout Sites register or the National Historic Lookout Register (checked the local crawl). Record coordinates 27.37306, -80.56139 not checked. The local USGS GNIS copy has no Adams tower or fire feature in St. Lucie County. A 2026 Watch Duty 'Adams Fire' in St. Lucie County is not linked to the tower and was not used. Two web-search hits (Lakeland Ledger, anyplaceamerica) returned 403 and were not read. Both Adams pages on the Forest Lookouts site other than adams1 are navigation lists only.
